sloka: यम् पालयसि धर्मम् त्वम् धृत्या च नियमेन च ।सवै राघवशार्दुल! धर्मस्त्वामभिरक्षतु ॥२-२५-३॥
transliteration: yam pālayasi dharmam tvam dhṛtyā ca niyamena ca ।savai rāghavaśārdula! dharmastvāmabhirakṣatu ॥2-25-3॥

translations.english: The duty which you are carrying out with courage and selfdiscipline, O tiger among the descendants of Raghu will alone protect you.
